body:
Thanks for sending an issue! Please fill in the following template to help quickly solve your problem.

### Describe the current behavior / 问题描述 (Mandatory / 必填)
            
测试用例：
4卡场景，大shape
m=185404, n=3072, k=4096
bf16，不带bias


问题原因：
mc2/all_gather_matmul_v2/op_kernel/all_gather_matmul_aiv_mode.h
    uint64_t gm_scale_workspace_st = aAlignSize + bAlignSize + m * n * worldSize * sizeof(int32_t);
    m * n * worldSize * sizeof(int32_t) = 9112977408，超过了uint32
    
修改：
uint64_t gm_scale_workspace_st = aAlignSize + bAlignSize + uint64_t(m) * n * worldSize * sizeof(int32_t);
